title: Cation–anion co-redox induced high-capacity cathode for high energy density sodium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12671-12676
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01409C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bing Zhang, Haoqing Ma, Feng Tao, Chengsifan Lei, Lei Zhang, Chaohui He, Meng Huang
A novel Co2+/Mg2+/Li+ co-doped P2-type manganese-based layered transition metal oxide is developed, and undergoes stable cationic and anionic co-redox reactions across the wide voltage window of 1.5–4.3 V, showing promise in practical applications.
